summary: Rabbi Besser discusses the actions of Yaakov Abinu in Parashat Vayesheb, specifically why he returned alone to retrieve small pitchers. He explores the idea that the righteous value their possessions because they are gifts from Hashem, and shares a commentary from the Siftei Cohen that connects a miraculous jug of oil used by Yaakov to the miracles of Hanukkah.
questions: Why did Yaakov Abinu return alone to retrieve his possessions?
What does the Gemara teach about the attitude of the righteous toward their belongings?
How does the Siftei Cohen connect the jug of oil from Yaakov's time to the miracle of Hanukkah?
